title: Colonial Quarter

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Colonial Oak Music Park is a most enchanting St. Augustine setting for weddings, corporate events and other private parties. A regular host to community and private gatherings - The Oak features an amphitheater under St. Augustine's second oldest sweeping live oak tree with enough family-style table seating for up to 175 guests. Our Oak space also features a full bar, and many different catered menu options from our on-site chef to please any crowd - we enjoy tailoring custom events to your needs! Since the famous St. Augustine Pirate & Treasure Museum is also located on site we can even provide you with pirates or re-enactors from the colonial period to mingle and entertain your guests

services.name: Climb the Watchtower
services.desc: Climb 35 feet to the top of our interpretation of a Spanish watchtower from the past for a birds-eye view of the Castillo de San Marcos and St. Augustine's bayfront.
